message:
fix(shared session, apk-0232 r2): a late local turn cannot take a newer pick's tracking; a held IDR asks the gate again

Codex codex_apk_prelogin_select_src_r1.md N1, N2.
- N1: a local selection's start (sink, panel, tracked tag) and the poll that completes it are one step each under
  localSelectMu_ (after parkMu_; no network under it). A queued pick A turned local late no longer publishes its tag
  over a newer pick B's (it waits, and takes no tag when the panel already holds B); cancelled, it completes nothing.
- N2: the Android sink's held input frame moves into DecoderPendingSlot (decoder_pending_slot.hpp, shared with the
  Windows test): the gate is asked again at the moment a frame would really go into the codec
  (SelectionAckGate::PermitsQueue -- waiting: nothing; unbound local: its current candidate IDR only; bound or
  answered: that generation) and a frame it no longer admits is dropped; a newer frame never overtakes a held one.
  The bootstrap replay asks the same. DebugStatus shows gateQueueDrops.

Product / test / docs: product (session, gate, decoder slot, Android decoder sink) / test (none in this commit) / docs (none).
